verdicts.title: Space Lower Bounds for Graph Stream Problems
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: This work concerns with proving space lower bounds for graph problems in the streaming model. It is known that computing the length of shortest path between two nodes in the streaming model requires $Ω(n)$ space, where $n$ is the number of nodes in the graph. We study the problem of finding the depth of a given node in a rooted tree in the streaming model. For this problem we prove a tight single pass space lower bound and a multipass space lower bound. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The cited paper focuses on space lower bounds for various graph problems in the streaming model, including shortest paths, depth of a node in a tree, min s-t cut, detecting negative weight cycles, and whether two nodes are in the same strongly connected component. It does not mention cumulative entropy or balanced separator size, which are key concepts in the conjecture under review.

verdicts.title: Space Lower Bounds for Online Pattern Matching
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We present space lower bounds for online pattern matching under a number of different distance measures. Given a pattern of length m and a text that arrives one character at a time, the online pattern matching problem is to report the distance between the pattern and a sliding window of the text as soon as the new character arrives.
